query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `examiner_email_templates` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `examiner_id` int NOT NULL,
  `template_type` enum('requirements','acceptance','rejection','fully_booked') NOT NULL,
  `subject` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  CONSTRAINT `examiner_email_templates_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`),
  INDEX `idx_examiner_email_tpl`(`examiner_id`, `template_type`)
);
